# Sports
A Chinese-language independent sports field guide.
- [Volleyball](/volleyball/): [rally rules](/volleyball/volleyball-rally/), [first practice](/volleyball/volleyball-first-practice/).
- [Fitness](/fitness/): [weekly activity](/fitness/fitness-week/), [training notes](/fitness/fitness-training-notes/).
- [Baseball](/baseball/): [innings](/baseball/baseball-innings/), [positions](/baseball/baseball-positions/).
Source links are in each article. No live scores or personal exercise records are published.

- [Agent reader](https://my-sports-lab.vercel.app/agent/) — site structure, source links and limits.
- [Structured catalog](https://my-sports-lab.vercel.app/agent/site.json) — same public reader data in JSON.
